The composite aggregation appears to filter noise better than individual rules; these deserve a cautious allocation when they fire with BIAS=NEUTRAL or L

The fixed $100 notional per trade ignores that VIRTUAL’s win rate and payoff are demonstrably superior, and that diversification across dead tokens is a drag. A simple Kelly-inspired allocation that overweights VIRTUAL and zeros out AERO/VVV/MORPHO would likely improve risk-adjusted returns.
